threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think you can get a seat on the tube during rush hour—bless your heart, mate. That’s when the real Londoners stand.
Caught a lad on the 35 bragging about how he ‘broke the tube strike’ by cycling all the way to Borough. Said it was like a scene from a movie.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: One night I saw a group of teens setting up a pop-up cinema in the park, complete with fairy lights and blankets. That's when it hit me.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can spot the spontaneous techno parties in hidden courtyards. Beats drop, people dance, and it feels like you stumbled into another world.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know the best alleyways for murals and the unmarked taco trucks that get the late-night crowd buzzing.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a tourist trying to explain how to catch a Muni bus to a local. The local just shrugged, smirked, and kept walking. Classic SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about the plazas, but it's the hidden calles that show true local life—where the real magic happens.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their confusion at the refuse collection schedule—only locals know it shifts for holidays.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still say 'going to the Tube' like it’s a quick jaunt, not a whole day’s saga of delays and packed carriages.
Last night on the 47, the driver was blasting 90s garage. Half the bus was vibing, the other half scowling. Classic South London night out.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw the old lady in the window feeding pigeons while deafening techno blasted from the street below. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a hidden Kiez-Kneipe that doubles as an art gallery and hosts poetry slams every Tuesday. It's like a cultural time capsule!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their tolerance for BART delays—only a true San Franciscan knows to pack snacks and a book for the commute.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo catching the 6 while holding a bouquet. I guess even Muni can't ruin a wedding vibe for everyone.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists flock to Parc Güell, but a quiet corner of Plaça del Sol has sunsets that locals keep to themselves. It's a whole different vibe.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by their reluctance to use the escalators at Diagonal; they insist on walking to be 'local' but don’t realize it's a workout.
